svg.title: How a whole project runs
svg.desc: Six stages from left to right. One, your brief with the scope and the files. Two, a written plan, free in one working day. Three, many thin agent lanes fan out in parallel. Four, every lane meets one review node, every change reviewed. Five, small pull requests with tests. Six, shipped to main. Below, a week axis with one written report every week, 18:00 CET.
svg.text: one written report every week, 18:00 CET
